en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small, forested town or village. Detached houses with steep, simple gable roofs and neat gardens line curving streets. Beyond the neighborhood are dense coniferous woods and open fields with a few scattered farm buildings and larger institutional‑looking structures. The landscape is gently rolling and heavily wooded, suggesting a northern European rural setting. No visible text appears on the image.
